market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil-driven inflation, bond yield volatility, and trade war escalation. AI capex names provide offsetting strength. Expect elevated VIX, dollar weakness, and sector rotation from defensives to energy/commodities. Bessent policy missteps create near-term uncertainty.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle remains multi-year structural tailwind. Energy transition (Brazil, LNG, data centers) creates durable demand. However, persistent inflation from oil and trade fragmentation could force prolonged higher-for-longer rates, compressing valuations. Consumer financial fragility is a medium-term drag on discretionary spending.
